entries.365096c084bf5524: The company has a system in which it consistently handles everything from product development to sales, implementation support, and maintenance and support with its own staff. It has agentless technology that records activity by placing a gateway server in between, without installing a small recording program on the target server, which makes it easy to deploy even on servers that handle important data. Maintenance support continues after licenses are deployed, and in the fiscal year ended March 2026 the maintenance renewal rate achieved 96%.
entries.44ba75db2dfb1ff0: This service provides improved versions of installed products, responds at a Q&A desk on usage methods, and provides product information. Continuing contracts with customers who have introduced licenses are the pillar of revenue, and revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,480 million.
entries.4af831b79be2c5c2: In April 2024, the company established its purpose, 'Creating a society where everyone can use IT with peace of mind', and its long-term vision 'VISION2030'. VISION2030 states that the company will create new value in the field of IT system operations management, such as privileged ID management and audit trail management, and that, in addition to a business model centered on products and maintenance, it will fully enter cloud services and expand solutions such as consulting services. The fiscal years from the year ended March 2025 to the year ending March 2027 are positioned as the investment phase of the first medium-term management plan, under which the company is advancing feature enhancements to existing products and the development of new products and cloud services.
entries.560508975b50c52f: The company is a software company established in 2002, with its head office in Hamacho, Nihonbashi, Chuo-ku, Tokyo. As of March 31, 2026, the company had 124 employees, and it handles everything from product development to sales, implementation support and maintenance with its own staff.
entries.5b384463925673e0: Starting from license sales, maintenance support services form the core of recurring revenue. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,584 million, up 3.3% from the previous year.

entries.636e4eb633c1edbe: In Japan, software investment is expanding across all industries, and highly effective information security measures are being required as countermeasures against ransomware attacks and information leaks caused by internal misconduct. The company focuses on security products for IT system operations management, and its dependence on the financial industry is relatively high.
entries.66b466efb760011a: The company provides packaged software that addresses security measures and strengthened internal controls in IT system operations management. Its core products are 'ESS AdminONE' for privileged ID management and 'ESS REC 6' for operation audit trail management, and it also offers a cloud version and a file sanitization product.
